known_risks: 中文：强制 JP v96 中高速收集效果 ID 的全部直接检查；#59 已直接加速剥取、采集动作与获取倍率，会掩盖本项差异。验证 #60 时请关闭 #59，并对同一采集点的完整循环计时。 / English: Forces every direct JP-v96 check for the Fast Gathering effect ID; #59 directly accelerates carving, gathering actions, and acquisition, which can mask this difference. To validate #60, disable #59 and time a complete cycle at the same gathering point.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #60“高速收集”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #60 "Fast Gathering" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
